ByteDance is a technology company developing products and platforms that inspire creativity and enrich life. The company is seeking a graduate Software Development Engineer to build software-defined networking systems for traffic intelligence and control, including network resource management and traffic monitoring. The role also supports network operations and planning teams with bandwidth performance requirements, fault analysis, and resolution capabilities.

Build software control systems to manage the network resources, especially the long haul bandwidth
Build host/gateway end-side network traffic monitoring, analysis and control capabilities
Working with network operation and planning teams to support bandwidth and performance requirements for upper-layer computing, storage, recommendation and other businesses, and provide fault analysis and resolving capabilities

- In-depth understanding of networking protocols and the TCP/IP stack
Preferred
Practical or research experience in the areas of bandwidth management or distributed rate limiting systems/algorithms will be considered particularly favorable
- In-depth understanding of networking protocols and the TCP/IP stack; familiarity with Linux operating systems and networking functionalities is highly advantageous
